description: The audio of ac3-signal-compr (exponents 6 higher than ac3-signal-unequal-bandwidth's, so 36 dB quieter) with compre set and a compr word of 0 dB (0x00) in the first six frames and compre 0 in the last six, dialnorm 27: to see whether a decoder that picks its output mode by the presence of compr changes its gain at the step, with no compr gain to confuse the steps.

skip.skip_insertion: The check rewrites E-AC-3 frames with skip fields.
